newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Australia to withdraw from ATPC - Bernama.
newsitem.headline: Australia to withdraw from ATPC - Bernama.

text.p: Australia has told Malaysia it is pulling out of the Association of Tin Producing Countries (ATPC) because the group served no useful purpose for Australia's industrial policy, the Bernama news agency reported on Wednesday.
It quoted Australian Resources Minister Warwick Parer as saying Australia's membership of the ATPC would cease from December 10.
It was Australian government policy to participate only in international organisations which have a clear national benefit, Parer said.
He said the decision reflected his government's commitment to end mineral export controls, other than for uranium, the news agency reported.
The ATPC was established in 1983 to stabilise the tin market and promote industry research.
However, Australia had never enforced tin quotas under the association's supply rationalisation scheme although it complied voluntarily for several years, Bernama said.
